listings.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------



ECS is seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst (CDAP) \- Journeyman to support the Army National Guard (ARNG) Enterprise Network Operations and Cybersecurity Support (ENOCS) program. In this Task 3 role supporting Cybersecurity Operations Support, the Analytic Developer/Insider Threat Analyst develops, implements, and tunes analytic rules and detection logic to identify anomalous user activity, insider threat indicators, and high\-risk behavioral patterns across ARNG enterprise environments. The position correlates data from multiple security and user activity sources, performs alert triage and investigative analysis, documents findings with supporting evidence, and supports case development and reporting in coordination with SOC/CIRT, CTIC, defensive cyber, and security engineering teams to strengthen Defensive Cyberspace Operations – Internal Defensive Measures (DCO\-IDM) across the DoDIN\-Army\-NG area of responsibility.





**Please Note: This position is contingent upon contract award.**





This role directly supports the ARNG mission to deliver and defend DoDIN services for more than 120,000 users and approximately 141,000 endpoints across roughly 2,800 sites in 54 states and territories, including Title 10 and Title 32 missions, mobilization readiness, domestic emergency response, and classified SIPRNet operations. The analyst contributes to a 24x7x365 cybersecurity operations environment that coordinates with the NETCOM Global Cyber Center and DISA DCDC and leverages ARNG's Unified Security Information \& Event Management (USIEM) analytics ecosystem, integrated SIEM/C2C/DLP analytics, MITRE ATT\&CK\-based detections, Zeek metadata, Sysmon\-informed monitoring, EDR, SOAR, and continuous monitoring processes to improve visibility, detection fidelity, and response across classified and unclassified network environments.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Develop, implement, and tune analytic rules, correlation logic, and behavioral detections to identify anomalous user activity, insider threat indicators, and high\-risk patterns across ARNG enterprise environments.
* Correlate data from multiple security and user activity sources to support triage, investigation, and evidence\-based analysis of alerts, suspicious behaviors, and potential insider threat activity.
* Perform in\-depth alert analysis and document investigative findings, recommended actions, and supporting artifacts for case development, reporting, and follow\-on response activities.
* Coordinate with SOC, CIRT, CTIC, defensive cyber, and security engineering personnel to validate findings, refine detection content, and support escalation through Tier 2 incident, problem, and change processes as appropriate.
* Create and improve MITRE ATT\&CK\-based analytics within the ARNG USIEM environment to enhance threat\-informed detection and centralized visibility.
* Support integration and refinement of detections using relevant enterprise data sources identified in ENOCS operations, including SIEM/C2C/DLP analytics, Zeek metadata, Sysmon\-based monitoring, EDR telemetry, and baseline/trend analysis.
* Coordinate with USIEM engineers and AESS\-aligned endpoint security stakeholders to improve enabling data sources, detection coverage, and analytic effectiveness across classified and unclassified enclaves.
* Ensure analytic development and investigative activities align with DoD and ARNG cybersecurity policy, insider threat program requirements, RMF controls, eMASS evidence expectations, and continuous monitoring objectives.
* Contribute to reporting and governance activities that strengthen cyber defense across the DoDIN\-Army\-NG AOR and support coordination with NETCOM, ARCYBER, USCYBERCOM, and RCC stakeholders when required.

Requirements:
**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------



U.S. Citizenship is required



Security Clearance: Secret Eligible



Required Certifications: DCWF Work Role 462\-Control Systems Security Specialist — Basic proficiency; must hold ONE OR MORE of the following: DAF 462 (Basic) (ICS)



Experience: 3\+ years of experience in cybersecurity


* Experience developing and tuning detection logic or analytic content for anomalous activity, behavioral indicators, or insider threat use cases.
* Experience correlating data from multiple security or user activity sources to support alert triage, investigative analysis, and documented findings.
* Ability to produce clear investigative documentation, supporting evidence, and reporting suitable for case development and stakeholder review.
* Experience coordinating with incident response, security operations, cyber intelligence, or security engineering teams to validate findings and improve detection outcomes.
* Familiarity with continuous monitoring objectives, RMF\-aligned security operations, and documenting artifacts that support ongoing cybersecurity compliance.
* Experience working within enterprise cybersecurity operations supporting classified and unclassified environments.

The **Insider Risk Analyst** is responsible for detecting, analyzing, and investigating potential insider‑driven risks to UnitedHealth Group's people, data, and systems. This role supports the Insider Risk Program by monitoring user activity, identifying anomalous or concerning behavior, conducting investigations, and partnering with cross‑functional stakeholders to mitigate risk while ensuring privacy, legal, and policy compliance.


The analyst will leverage technical data sources, behavioral indicators, and investigative techniques to assess risk, support casework, and contribute to the continuous improvement of insider risk detection and response capabilities.

**Insider Risk Detection \& Analysis**

* Monitor and analyze user activity, system logs, and alerts to identify potential insider risk indicators, including data exfiltration, misuse of access, policy violations, or negligent behavior.
* Perform analytical triage of insider risk alerts generated from enterprise security tools (e.g., SIEM, DLP, endpoint, identity, and email systems).
* Establish baseline user behavior and identify deviations that may indicate insider risk activity.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with HR, Legal, Compliance, Employee Relations, Privacy, and Information Security teams during insider risk reviews and investigations.
* Support escalation and coordination with Enterprise Information Security for incidents requiring broader security response.

**Program \& Process Improvement**

* Contribute to the development and enhancement of insider risk policies, procedures, and standard operating processes.
* Assist in defining insider risk indicators, metrics, and reporting to support program maturity.
* Support audits, assessments, and program evaluations related to insider risk management.

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Criminal Justice, or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience in cybersecurity
* 3\+ years of experience in security analysis, investigations, insider risk, threat analysis, or digital forensics
* 2\+ years of experience with working knowledge of security logs, user activity monitoring, and investigative techniques
* 2\+ years of experience of documenting findings clearly and communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical audiences

* Experience supporting an insider risk, fraud, compliance, or digital forensics program

* Troubleshooting hardware issues, computers, laptops, monitors, printers, scanners, and other peripherals
* Managing user accounts, password resets, and access permissions through Active Directory
* Supporting Microsoft 365 / Office 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint
* Troubleshooting network connectivity issues including LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP
* Managing endpoint security, antivirus, and data backup processes across all hospital devices
* Ensuring all IT systems and activities comply with HIPAA regulations and PHI data security requirements at all times

* Training new and existing staff on EPower and other hospital software and creating simple reference guides when needed
* Logging, tracking, and documenting all IT support requests through a ticketing system from open to resolution

* ITIL Foundation

* Stable full\-time Monday through Friday schedule

* Hands\-on experience with healthcare IT in a real clinical setting

listings.description:
**Who we are:**


Illumia is an industry leader in bringing the best integrated technology solutions to education, healthcare, and business campuses worldwide. **What you will be doing:**


The Technical Support Engineer I for Illumia's Campus Commerce Solutions, is the frontline expert for customers relying on Illumia's Point of Sale and Mobile Ordering solutions across higher education, healthcare, and corporate campuses. This role combines deep product knowledge with strong customer relationship skills to diagnose complex issues, deliver lasting solutions, and ensure customers achieve maximum value from their technology investment.


**Job Summary / Purpose**


* The Technical Support Engineer I owns the end\-to\-end support experience for customers using Illumia's POS and mobile ordering platforms — from initial triage through resolution and documentation.
* This role serves as a key liaison between customers, Subject Matter Experts, and cross\-functional teams, providing technical expertise and clear communication at every stage of the support lifecycle.

**Who you will work with:**


This role reports directly to a Support Manager and collaborates closely with Senior Technical Support Engineers, Subject Matter Experts, and Support Engineers across Illumia's product lines.


You will engage cross\-functionally with Product and Engineering teams through Senior Technical Support Engineers, contributing customer insights and feedback to ongoing product improvements. You will coordinate directly with third\-party vendors to support troubleshooting and resolution of issues that span Illumia's platform and external systems. You will interface directly with customers ranging from IT administrators and system integrators to end\-users at universities, hospitals, and corporate campuses — requiring clear and adaptable communication across a wide range of technical backgrounds.


**Key Responsibilities and Duties**


* Owns the full support lifecycle for POS and mobile ordering cases — triaging, diagnosing, resolving, and documenting issues with defined quality standards and SLAs.

* Coordinates with third\-party vendors to troubleshoot and resolve issues that span Illumia's platform and external systems, managing communication and follow\-through on both sides.

* Documents solutions, known issues, and troubleshooting procedures in the knowledge base to drive team efficiency and enable customer self\-service.
* Contributes to process improvement initiatives that enhance support delivery, reduce repeat contacts, and improve the overall customer experience.
* Surfaces customer\-reported defects, trends, and enhancement requests through Senior Technical Support Engineers — serving as the voice of the customer in product feedback loops.

**What you bring to the table:**


The following qualifications are required or preferred for the Technical Support Engineer 1 role.


Required Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
* 1–2 years of professional experience in a customer\-facing, technical, or operations role.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a structured approach to working through complex issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and keep stakeholders informed.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, stay organized, and work independently in a fast\-moving environment.
* A customer\-first mindset with patience, professionalism, and a genuine commitment to delivering great experiences.

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience in retail, food service, hospitality, or campus operations — particularly in environments involving POS systems, ordering platforms, or technology\-assisted workflows.
* Comfort working with or around technology in a professional setting, whether supporting users, troubleshooting day\-to\-day issues, or learning new tools quickly.
* Familiarity with mobile applications, web\-based platforms, or self\-service technology.
* Any experience working with systems that connect to or communicate with other software or services.
* Experience with ticketing, scheduling, or operations software.

The duties and responsibilities described in this job description are intended to represent the essential functions of the position as defined under applicable federal, state, and local labor laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). These functions are the fundamental job duties required for successful performance.

  

  

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions unless such accommodations impose an undue hardship on the organization.


This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities. Duties may be added, removed, or modified at any time in accordance with business needs and applicable law.


**What is good to know:**


This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support customers in different time zones or during critical system implementations. Some travel may be required for on\-site support or training (typically less than 5%). This role offers meaningful growth opportunities within a team structure that recognizes and rewards technical development and career progression.


**Key Areas of Focus**


* Own the Customer Experience: Takes accountability for every case from first contact to resolution — communicating proactively, setting clear expectations, and following through until the customer is fully back on track.
* Master the Product: Builds deep familiarity with Illumia's POS and mobile ordering ecosystem, including integrations, hardware dependencies, and common failure patterns, to resolve issues faster and more effectively over time.
* Document and Share: Treats knowledge as a team asset — captures what's learned from every complex case and contributes to a knowledge base that makes the whole team stronger.
* Drive, Curiosity, and Judgment: Asks the right questions, digs past symptoms to root cause, and knows when to escalate versus when to keep troubleshooting independently.

**Competencies and Behaviors**


* **Humble:** The best teammates at Illumia don't need to own the spotlight — they share credit, celebrate the wins of those around them, and are quick to ask for help when they need it. This is a company that still writes its story, and the people who thrive here find energy in being part of something bigger than themselves.
* **Hungry:** We are not looking for people who just close tickets. We are looking for people who are genuinely curious about how things work, motivated to build their skills and knowledge over time, and who take pride in getting to the right answer — not just the fastest one.
* **Smart:** At Illumia, our team members operate across a complex organization serving thousands of customers with diverse needs and competing priorities. Technical aptitude matters, but so does knowing when to ask questions, when to escalate, and how to communicate clearly with customers who may be frustrated or under pressure. The people who thrive here combine curiosity with good judgment — and understand that how you help someone is just as important as whether you solved the problem.

**Position:** Systems Administrator Jr


**Location:** Athens Campus


**Department:** Information Technology


**Reports to:** Director of Information Technology


**Salary/Benefits:** Salary is commensurate with education and experience. State of Georgia benefits package.


**Deadline to Apply:** June 17, 2026 at 4:00 p.m.

* Work daily within systems such as Servers, Switches, and Databases.
* Prepare reports in requested format within requested time frames.
* Perform database data manipulation and extraction using MySQL to support business intelligence needs and custom reporting requests.
* Oversee core network infrastructure daily, ensuring optimal connectivity through the configuration of switches, access points, and DHCP protocols.

* Work effectively in a diverse community and meet the needs of diverse student populations.

* Present ideas in user\-friendly language.
* Demonstrate highly self\-motivated and directed actions, with keen attention to detail.
* Demonstrate a sense of creativity, helpful for developing new processes.
* Demonstrate analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Demonstrate strong customer service orientation skills.
* Work in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.
* Develop and/or assist with the advancement of policies and procedures and recommend changes to effectively meet the goals and requirements of the department.
* Maintain knowledge of assigned department and give updates to management on services, operations, and projects.
* Participating in meetings to ensure department goals are in line with agency or technical college goals.

* Maintain excellent working relationships with, and serve as a liaison to, internal and external customers.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* High School Diploma and Certifications in related field(s).

* Three (3\) years of full\-time work experience installing and maintaining infrastructure hardware and software such as Servers, Networks, Computers, and Databases.

* Scripting: Strong experience with PowerShell scripting and Python. Ability to write a basic script from scratch on demand.
* Cisco Network Experience (networking\\wireless).
* Linux proficiency, including CLI.
* Virtualization proficiency (Experience in Nutanix and Vmware a plus).
* Management of data center infrastructure such as rack/blade servers, network switches (Cisco experience a plus), and SANs.
* Experience in application deployment, compliance, software updates, etc. (Intune, PDQ, SCCM, etc).
* Experience in Active Directory, EntraID, M365, and Cloud Compute platforms (Experience i a plus: Azure and AWS).

listings.description:
**Join our growing IT team in this new position as our IT Support Specialist!**

**General Summary**

The IT Support Specialist provides front\-line technical support in a Microsoft 365\-based environment, ensuring reliable operation of end\-user devices, collaboration tools, and communication systems. This role is the primary point of contact for IT support and plays a key role in maintaining user productivity and a high\-quality technology experience.

**Essential Job Functions**

· Provide day\-to\-day technical support for hardware, software, and user issues

· Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Windows devices and peripherals, mobile devices, Microsoft 365 services, Teams (including basic Teams Phone), user access issues, file access and sync issues, and connectivity problems

· Create and configure new user accounts

· Coordinate and perform new hire onboarding and setup

· Provide user training on Microsoft 365 tools and security best practices

· Disable and deprovision accounts for departing users

· Manage account access, password resets, and licensing

· Configure and maintain desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals

· Support email, file storage, and collaboration tools

· Track and resolve tickets using a ticketing system

· Maintain documentation

· Assist with asset management

· Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements

· Collaborates with other IT team members to ensure efficient resolution of issues and alignment with organizational standards

**Qualifications**

**Required**:

· Experience with Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365

· Strong troubleshooting skills

· Strong communication skills

· Ability to manage multiple priorities

· Ability to follow documented processes and adhere to IT standards

listings.title: RevOps Systems Administrator
listings.description:
**Revenue Operations (RevOps) Systems Administrator**



Revenue Operations • Hireology • Chicago, IL • Full\-Time



**About the Role**
------------------



We are seeking a proactive, curious, and adaptable RevOps Systems Administrator with 5\+ years of system administration experience to join our Revenue Operations team and be a solutions partner across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product. In this dynamic and multifaceted role, you’ll own our go\-to\-market tech stack, connecting our tools, data, and teams.



This is not a narrowly scoped admin role — it’s hands\-on, cross\-functional, and ideal for someone who thrives with autonomy, moves fast in ambiguity, and holds themselves accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.



If you like digging into data, connecting the dots across systems, troubleshooting the hard stuff, and leaving things better than you found them, we’d love to meet you.



**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------



**Tech Stack Ownership \& Architecture**


* Serve as the primary owner and architect of Hireology’s Revenue Operations tech stack. You are responsible for how our systems work, how they integrate, and how they evolve.
* Maintain deep, current knowledge of each platform in our stack, proactively identifying capability gaps, redundancies, or integration opportunities before they become problems.
* Own the cross\-system data flow: ensure that data moves cleanly and consistently across platforms, and that integrations are healthy, documented, and built to last.
* Drive tool consolidation, configuration improvements, and integration enhancements across the stack.
* Serve as the team’s first point of contact for new tool evaluations and integration assessments, bringing structured analysis and a clear point of view to those conversations.


*Our current stack includes: HubSpot, Salesforce, 6sense, Gong, DocuSign, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Nooks, and more. We also collaborate closely with teams that own ZoomInfo, RingLead, Zendesk, Vanta, and Zuora.*


**Salesforce Administration \& Platform Ownership**


* Act as the primary Salesforce Administrator (Sales Cloud). This is a required foundation, not the ceiling of the role.
* Own overall platform health: user access, profiles and permissions, record types, flows, reports, dashboards, and validation rules.
* Manage regular platform hygiene: data cleanups, sandbox refreshes, package administration, and release readiness.
* Partner with a Salesforce developer to determine the right blend of declarative and programmatic solutions.


*While Salesforce is your required foundation, other platforms in our stack will frequently be the priority. Over time you should be as comfortable owning HubSpot or 6sense as you are owning Salesforce.*


**Cross\-Stack Troubleshooting \& Problem Solving**


* Be the team’s primary troubleshooter. When something breaks, behaves unexpectedly, or doesn’t match expectations, you’re the first line of investigation.
* Diagnose issues that span multiple systems: why didn’t this trigger, where did this data come from, why don’t these reports match. Resolve them end\-to\-end.
* Approach ambiguous problems with structure: form a hypothesis, test it, document what you find, and communicate the outcome clearly.
* Research and resolve independently before escalating. You know how to use documentation, sandbox environments, and your own instincts to work through the hard stuff.


**Stakeholder Partnership \& Process Design**


* Work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into system solutions.
* Gather requirements, recommend improvements, and deliver solutions that are thoughtful, scalable, and documented.
* Help streamline and optimize lead\-to\-revenue processes through configuration, automation, and tool enhancements.
* Communicate system changes, updates, and best practices clearly across the RevOps team and the departments we support.


**AI Tooling \& Innovation**


* Actively engage with AI tools as part of how you work, including Claude, which our team uses to accelerate research, documentation, analysis, and system problem\-solving.
* Bring a genuine curiosity about how AI can extend the capabilities of our tech stack, surfacing new tools, use cases, or workflows that make the team sharper and faster.
* Experience with AI\-assisted operations workflows is a plus; openness and enthusiasm for learning and applying them is required.


**Tool Evaluation \& Vendor Involvement**


* Serve as the team’s primary point of contact for new tool and integration evaluations, assessing fit, surfacing risks, and making a clear recommendation.
* Engage with vendor reps and stay current on platform roadmaps and capabilities across the stack.
* Partner with RevOps leadership on contract renewals. Your hands\-on context around usage, value, and gaps directly informs those conversations.


**Access Management, Onboarding \& Compliance**


* Own system onboarding and offboarding across the stack.
* Manage user access, permissions, and provisioning with accuracy and a security\-first mindset.
* Serve as RevOps’ primary point of contact for SOC 2 compliance work, partnering with Engineering and our Vanta administration to ensure our systems meet requirements.


**Documentation \& Workflow Management**


* Track work through Salesforce Cases and Jira. Keep your queue current and your communication proactive.
* Maintain accurate, useful documentation in Confluence.
* Follow change management practices that ensure transparency, continuity, and zero surprises for the teams that depend on these systems.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in a systems administration or GTM operations role (inclusive of Salesforce), with demonstrated ownership of tools and processes across the full stack.
* Salesforce Admin experience (Sales Cloud) includes strong working knowledge of the data model, flows, Data Loader, reporting, and dashboards.
* Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM\-201\) is a plus.
* Comfortable managing Salesforce platform maintenance tasks: sandbox refreshes, release readiness, installed packages, and data quality.
* Experience collaborating with Salesforce developers to evaluate and implement both declarative and custom solutions.
* Familiarity with additional RevOps tools — HubSpot, 6sense, Gong, DocuSign, or similar — and a genuine interest in going deep on whatever the stack requires.
* A troubleshooter’s instinct: you form a hypothesis, test it, document what you find, and resolve before escalating.
* Ability to analyze and interpret data, draw conclusions, and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with or active interest in AI tools as part of your day\-to\-day workflow. Openness to learning and applying new AI capabilities is expected.
* Strong organizational skills, a detail\-oriented mindset, and the ability to manage competing priorities without losing quality.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and cross\-functionally, with a track record of taking ownership and following through.
* Comfortable with the unglamorous parts of the role: onboarding, offboarding, documentation, platform maintenance.

**Why This Role**
-----------------


* You’ll own the infrastructure, not a slice of it. This role comes with real accountability for how our tech stack functions across systems, across teams, and across the full data lifecycle. If you want a seat at the table where the architecture decisions get made, this is it.
* You’ll have autonomy to do the work your way. We’re not going to hand you a script. We’ll align on priorities and outcomes, and then trust you to figure out the how. If you do your best work when you’re given room to move, this environment is built for you.
* The stack will keep growing, and so will you. There will always be something new to learn, evaluate, or build. If that energizes you, you’ll thrive here.
* You’ll be surrounded by people who take this work seriously. Our RevOps team values precision, accountability, and continuous improvement, and we expect the same from each other.
* We’re investing in AI and we want you to help lead that. We use tools like Claude to make our team faster and sharper, and we’re actively looking for ways to extend that across our stack. If you’ve been waiting for a team that takes AI tooling seriously, this is it.

  



**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------


* Base salary: $100,000 (plus 10% bonus)
* Health, Dental, and Vision coverage from day one
* 401(k) with company match
* Unlimited PTO and mental health days
* External learning budget

Real career advancement * \- we promote from within

  


**Must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to provide Visa sponsorship. Agency and/or Third Party inquiries will not be accepted.**

All employment decisions are solely based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We support an inclusive workplace where Hireologists excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.*
